description: This header file declares internal API functions for the Sys Rro Uint object in the BroadWay Runtime System environment. It includes function prototypes related to accessing and setting record data and values for the object.

methods.name: SysRroUintGetRecordData
methods.description: Retrieves the record data into a provided buffer, updating size information.

methods.name: SysRroUintSetRecordData
methods.description: Sets the record data from a provided buffer, specifying the size.

methods.name: SysRroUintGetRecordValue
methods.description: Gets the current record value as an unsigned long.

methods.name: SysRroUintSetRecordValue
methods.description: Sets the record value with an unsigned long.
